main_text.p: עצוא Ch. Mactra. Idem quod אצוא. Plur. עצון.
בצצ Syr. Contentio, concertatio, Trem. 2. ad Cor. 12.20. & ad Gal.5.20. In Reg. Calumniae.
עצב Ch. Dolere, Dolore affici, Esth.4.1. Eccles.7.5. Syr. Obligare vulnus, Lucae 10.34.

עציץ עצוצא Ch. Vas testaceum, matula, scaphium, כלי חרם, ut Commentator Hebraeus explicat: הורת מקלקלא בכל יומא ויומא בריא עצוצא Cospurcabat quotidie stercore matulam, id est, ut Translatio Judaica habet; Sic friegte den שלשול, id est, dysenteria vel diarrhoeam, Esth.5.1. Talmudici scribunt עציצא.
עצר Ch. Premere, exprimere, calcare. עצר, עצור Ch. Calcans, calcator, Plur. עצרין, עצורין, Jesa. 16.10. quomodo & melius legeretur, Jer.48.33. pro עצורין.
עצורין Ch Cortices, cutes uvarum, Num.6.4.
מעצרתא מעצרתא Ch.& Syr. Torcular, Lacus torcularis, Plur. מעצרין, מעצריא, Jesa. 16.10. & foeminin. מעצרתא, Jobi 24.11.
מעצור Ch. Prohibitio, impedimentum, ut Hebr. 1.Samuel.14.6.
עצרת Ch. Festum, Feria, Dies feriatus. Sic vocantur Octavus festi tabernaculorum, & Ultimus paschatis, Esth.3.8. in Targ.sec. Plur. cum Aff. בעצרתיכון In festis vestris, Num.28.26.
עקב Syr. Quaerere, exquirere, inquirere, pervestigare, examinare. Hinc etiam in Targ. Partic. ex Pahel ומעקבא בית מזנא Et investigates domum

page.notes: Several Hebrew and Syriac words are reproduced approximately; the printed Hebrew/Aramaic letters in some entries (e.g. the Gothic "friegte den" phrase and the Hebrew at line ends) are doubtful. The lower-right mark after the last line is unclear. Catchword and signature not visible.
